title: Global funds turn wary of Indian stocks as AI boom draws money elsewhere
text: Global funds turn wary of Indian stocks as AI boom draws money elsewhere. India's appeal to global fund managers is weakening amid muted corporate earnings and the lack of a major AI investment theme, pushing foreign ownership of NSE-listed companies to a 17-year low
